title: A normal extension is normal over every intermediate field (Stacks 09HN)
statement: Let $F\subseteq K\subseteq E$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension] such that $E/F$ is algebraic and normal: every $\alpha\in E$ is algebraic over $F$ [def-weil-algebraic-element] and its minimal polynomial over $F$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] is a product of polynomials of degree one in $E[T]$. Then $E/K$ is algebraic and normal: every $\alpha\in E$ is algebraic over $K$ and its minimal polynomial over $K$ is a product of polynomials of degree one in $E[T]$.
